issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to call setup_env() with no parameters, but the solution calls setup_env after pushing a parameter (push 1) and declares extern setup_env. The template does not declare or call setup_env at all. This mismatch between the problem, template, and solution about whether setup_env takes parameters (and whether it should be invoked at all) can confuse students about the required change and the expected program behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the intent consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement to require calling setup_env with one integer parameter (and document the meaning), and ensure the template declares extern setup_env and the solution keeps push 1 / call setup_env; or (B) change the solution to call setup_env with no parameters (remove the push 1) and update the solution and template to include extern setup_env and a parameterless call. Prefer updating the template to include 'extern setup_env' and a call that matches the problem text so students can follow a minimal edit (i.e., call setup_env with no parameters) or update the problem text to match the implemented solution.
